AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: LifeOS is the primary personal workspace app for managing calendar events, tasks, notes, habits, and financial bills. Operational Patterns: - Use 'queryEvents' or 'createEvent' to query or schedule meetings, calendar events, or appointments. - Use 'queryTasks', 'createTask', or 'markTaskCompleted' to query, add, or complete tasks and to-dos. - Use 'queryNotes' or 'createNote' to search or create personal notes. - Use 'queryMoneySummary' or 'createBill' to check financial overview, pending bills, or add new bills. - Use 'createHabit' to add habit trackers. - Use 'getLifeOSInsights' to get a complete workspace summary of events, open tasks, and status. Constraints: - Always invoke LifeOS when the user asks to manage, query, or add tasks, events, notes, bills, or habits.
